subject: Internal Review 1188/26 of FOI 719/26
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Good Afternoon,

I write to advise that I am in receipt of your e-mail dated 27/09/26 requesting an Internal Review of FOI 719/26.

This letter confirms that your request has now been passed to our FOI officers who will review the contents of your request and establish if a) your request is valid under the FOI Act and b) if any further clarification is required from you to allow us to progress further.

Please be advised that we are currently dealing with a high volume of requests. Whilst we make every effort to respond to all requests within the 20 working day deadline, there may be delays in the handling of some of the requests as a result.

Should you wish to contact us regarding your request, please quote reference number 1188/26 on any correspondence. Should you wish to contact us by e-mail, please do so using the mailbox [email redacted]<[email redacted]>.

Kind Regards,

Clare Mccarley
